text:
Mike: Afternoon check-in — quick async standup.
What I did: landed the gateway header rewrite PR (https://git.redwood/example/PR/842).
Blockers: seeing intermittent 429s in staging when our load tests run concurrent suites, unclear if it's routing policy or token churn.
Today: triage the 429s, run a focused ramp, pair with Priya on auth token rotation logs.

Priya: Thanks — I'll rerun the staged load with the new header and collect traces. Want me to bump to 50rps for 30s and attach trace ids? @Mike

Mike: Yes please. Use `k6 run --vus 50 --duration 30s gateway-ramp.js` and paste the trace ids here. Also include `x-request-id` samples.

Olivia: On routing: finished the routing-policy migration draft and added the fallback rules section. Link in #eng-platform-docs. Need a short review on the fallback TTL and priority ordering.

Sam: FYI I saw the 11:05 spike — briefly hit ~2.8% 429s on canary. I pushed a temporary rate-limit override (low impact) to relieve users, then reverted. Logs show bursts aligned with CI job that retries hard.

deploy-bot: canary deploy success: gateway-service v2.3.4 -> us-west-2 (rolled at 2026-03-17T18:40:00Z) :white_check_mark:

Mike: Can we add an alert for combined 429+5xx rate > 2% over a 5m window? If someone volunteers I can draft the alert conditions and dashboard widgets.

Priya: I'll own the alert. Will open a tiny PR to alerting-config and add a dashboard tile.

Olivia: Review ping: routing-migration PR needs one more approval — @Sam could you take a quick look at the priority ordering section? Should be a 5-min skim.

Sam: On it, doing a quick pass now.

Mike: Thanks all. If the 429s persist after the focused ramp, we'll roll back header changes and run the canary again. For anything urgent, ping #eng-oncall. :thumbsup:
